scientific_boundary: This snapshot records the closeout of the decks-2/3 interleaved combination-rule derivation and the resulting Coordinator decision DEC-20260830-680f6d. Neither finding establishes, conditionally or otherwise, any claim about the possibility or impossibility of a public sub-Theta(B^3) constructor for r_R mod g_I in general. Pollard rho remains the realized frontier. The goal's next_action redirects to a bounded mathematical-derivation task on the degree-provenance question rather than a further toy-construction round, since the engine-level blocker would recur identically for any other deck pair with no new information; the standing fourteenth trigger-search round remains available as a fallback.
